scope: Fresh Windows Sandbox. Exact v1.2.0 installer; updater logic identical to production except test service LatestReleaseApi redirected to localhost mock endpoint. Production v1.2.0 service re-tested afterward against real GitHub latest.

handoff.message: Verified v1.2.0; installing directly without UAC.

failuresConvertedToRegression: CTRL_UPDATE constant existed without Handler case -> contract now requires case CTRL_UPDATE and Task.Run(RunUpdateAsync).
HttpClient release-asset body stalled in Sandbox while API/checksum succeeded -> Windows system curl.exe used only as transport; trust remains independent dual SHA-256 gate.
LocalSystem updater could otherwise install user payload under system profile -> updater requires registered HKLM InstallLocation, validates expected user app/manifest, and passes explicit /DIR.
Initial identity validator serialized a large PowerShell object -> scalar bounded validator used; product outcome unaffected.
limitations: v1.2.0 is not published yet; GitHub v1.1.0 remains the public release.
Existing v1.1.0 Windows installations require one privileged upgrade to v1.2.0 because v1.1.0 does not contain update control 131.
